answer.camera_language: Locked village tableaux let rain and silence carry the scene; a single deliberate push gives C-17 evidentiary weight, then still frames restore Aruni's isolation.
answer.arc: Quiet approach rises through recognition, pauses before the key reveal at 5, then subsides into an unanswered appeal and distant, immovable silence.

clips.motivation: Establish the gate as a distant destination while the wet foreground supplies movement.
clips.opens_on: Wide view through soft paddy blades at lower left, with the distant gate high at frame right.
clips.lands_on: The same wide paddy foreground and distant gate, with no people visible.
clips.angle_reason: The ground-level view makes the wet paddy loom and withholds a clear view of the bank.
clips.composition_note: Soft blades cover the lower and left edges; the gate remains small at upper right.
clips.why: Establishing 1: the production's locked-off village framing lets rain animate the distance without prematurely revealing the discovery.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a low, ground-level wide view through soft foreground paddy, keeping the distant canal gate high at frame right throughout.

clips.motivation: Let her ordinary walking rhythm stop inside an indifferent landscape.
clips.opens_on: Wide field-side view with Aruni left and Nimal low at the gate on the right.
clips.lands_on: The same wide view with Aruni stopped facing the gate and Nimal still low right.
clips.composition_note: The diagonal path leads from Aruni on the left to the gate and body on the right.
clips.why: Arrival 2: a production-mandated locked frame lets Aruni's stop, rather than camera movement, interrupt the ordinary journey.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold an eye-level wide view from the field side as Aruni approaches and stops, retaining the diagonal path and the still figure low at the gate on the right.

clips.trigger: Aruni's stopped attention establishes the discovery.
clips.motivation: Identify Nimal plainly and allow the absence of movement to become the evidence of death.
clips.opens_on: Medium view of Nimal lying diagonally, head right and closed fist near the lower edge.
clips.lands_on: The same medium view of his motionless face, shirt and closed fist.
clips.angle_reason: A modest downward view onto the low bank exposes the prone figure without turning him into a looming threat.
clips.composition_note: His head occupies the right third; the gate provides a fixed background reference.
clips.why: Reveal 4: the village's locked-off language makes Nimal's unbroken stillness the discovery, reserving the sole moving emphasis for the key.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a slightly high medium view just above the bank, with Nimal diagonal across the frame, his head right and closed fist near the lower edge.

clips.trigger: Recognition settles as Aruni lowers her gaze.
clips.motivation: Make the audience stay with her contained response without providing a camera-led release.
clips.opens_on: Close-up of Aruni looking down and right, with soft paddy behind.
clips.lands_on: The same close-up with her lowered gaze held in the frame.
clips.composition_note: Leave a small amount of room toward her downward-right eyeline rather than centring the look into an edge.
clips.why: Realisation 4: the production's sustained locked close-up gives recognition time to land without embellishing her restraint.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold an eye-level close-up of Aruni as her gaze lowers, keeping her face isolated against soft paddy and a little space toward her downward-right look.

clips.motivation: Connect her decision to kneel with the body while allowing the gesture to remain private.
clips.opens_on: Two-shot with Aruni standing left and Nimal lying low right, gate behind.
clips.lands_on: The same two-shot with Aruni kneeling left and her sleeve obscuring the hand contact.
clips.angle_reason: The downward view onto the bank places the eventual kneeling figure beside the prone body without granting either a dominant angle.
clips.composition_note: Aruni occupies the left third and Nimal the lower right; retain the sleeve's existing occlusion of contact.
clips.why: Intimacy 3: the production's locked two-shot lets her lowering close the emotional distance without the camera intruding on contact.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a slightly high two-shot from hip height as Aruni kneels, ending with her at frame left beside Nimal low right and the hand contact behind her sleeve.

clips.trigger: Her right arm remains extended below frame.
clips.motivation: Create a quiet interval between the concealed contact and the key's disclosure.
clips.opens_on: Medium close-up of kneeling Aruni facing down and right, right arm leaving the lower edge.
clips.lands_on: The same medium close-up, her chin slightly lower and the object of attention unseen.
clips.composition_note: Centre her face while leaving the extended arm to exit the bottom edge.
clips.why: Tension 2: a quiet locked frame follows the production style and creates the stillness needed immediately before the key peak.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold an eye-level medium close-up of kneeling Aruni as her chin lowers, keeping her face centred and her extended right arm leaving the bottom of the frame.

clips.direction: straight toward the marked key edge
clips.trigger: The visible C-17 edge is established between the closed fingers.
clips.motivation: Make the enclosed key, rather than the death alone, the scene's decisive new question.
clips.opens_on: Insert of Nimal's closed fist with the narrow marked metal edge visible between his fingers.
clips.lands_on: Extreme close-up of the enclosed key edge and C-17, bordered by still fingers.
clips.angle_reason: The downward finder-like view makes the visible gap between the fingers legible without changing the fist's position.
clips.composition_note: Keep the marked metal edge at the optical centre as the surrounding fist moves toward the frame edges.
clips.why: Reveal 5: this evidentiary turn earns the sole exception to the production's locked frames, with a visible push that enlarges C-17 and then holds it.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly high insert of the closed fist, slowly push toward the visible marked key edge, then hold an extreme close-up of C-17 between the fingers.

clips.trigger: Aruni registers the detail in Nimal's fist.
clips.motivation: Return from the emphatic object view to a withheld, unreadable human response.
clips.opens_on: Medium close-up of kneeling Aruni centred, eyes down, gate soft behind.
clips.lands_on: The same medium close-up with her eyes held slightly farther downward.
clips.composition_note: Match setup E's face placement and downward-right eyeline.
clips.why: Realisation 4: returning to the production's locked setup after the settled key push connects discovery to Aruni without inventing an interpretation.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold the eye-level medium close-up of kneeling Aruni, keeping her face centred as her eyes settle downward, ending on the same restrained framing.

clips.trigger: Aruni begins her quiet appeal to Dinu.
clips.motivation: Let the voice test the silence without camera movement promising reassurance.
clips.opens_on: Close-up of Aruni's rain-wet face, gaze down and right.
clips.lands_on: The same close-up after her lips close.
clips.composition_note: Keep a narrow pocket of space toward the low right eyeline; preserve this framing for G-2.
clips.why: Tension 3: the production's locked close-up protects the quiet spoken appeal and leaves its need unanswered within the frame.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold an eye-level close-up throughout Aruni's quiet appeal, with slight room toward her lowered rightward gaze, ending on her face after her lips close.

clips.trigger: The appeal gives way to a held practical detail.
clips.motivation: Contrast the medical bag's potential usefulness with her hand's present immobility.
clips.opens_on: Insert of Aruni's left hand around the bag handle beside her bent knee, sleeve near the edge.
clips.lands_on: The same hand, handle and knee detail as water runs off the bag.
clips.angle_reason: Looking down at the low-held bag separates her professional equipment from any capacity to help.
clips.composition_note: The wet sleeve borders the near edge; the hand and handle remain centred low with the knee behind.
clips.why: Isolation 3: the production's locked detail holds on unused medical equipment while rain supplies the only movement.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a high, downward insert through the near sleeve edge, keeping Aruni's left hand and the top of her bag centred low beside her bent knee as water runs off.

clips.trigger: Aruni raises the phone from her lap.
clips.motivation: Make the attempt to connect a simple, fully readable action within an unchanged frame.
clips.opens_on: Medium profile of kneeling Aruni with the bag at her left knee and phone low in her right hand.
clips.lands_on: The same medium profile with the phone at her right ear and bag still at her knee.
clips.composition_note: Retain space in front of her right-facing profile and include both the low bag and phone's upward path.
clips.why: Tension 3: the production's locked medium frame makes the phone lift clear while refusing any anticipatory move toward a reply.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold an eye-level medium profile as the phone rises from Aruni's lap to her ear, ending with the phone at frame right and the bag beside her knee.

clips.trigger: Aruni listens without receiving an answer.
clips.motivation: Give the absent response duration rather than replacing it with a new visual event.
clips.opens_on: Close-up of Aruni's face and phone against her right ear.
clips.lands_on: The same close-up, still waiting with the phone at her ear.
clips.composition_note: Match G-1's face position and low-right looking space, now occupied in part by the phone.
clips.why: Isolation 4: the production's long locked reaction makes the unanswered interval itself the pressure, with no second moving climax.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold the eye-level close-up of Aruni and the phone at her right ear throughout the wait, ending on the same rain-wet face and unanswered handset.

clips.direction: fixed on phone edge and fingers
clips.trigger: The unanswered wait continues in her unchanged grip.
clips.motivation: Make the stalled connection tactile without implying another attempt or a screen notification.
clips.opens_on: Extreme close-up of the phone edge beside Aruni's right ear, fingers filling the lower foreground.
clips.lands_on: The same phone edge and fixed fingers, with rain travelling over them.
clips.composition_note: Use the vertical phone edge as the central anchor; crop the face away and isolate the grip.
clips.why: Tension 3: a production-consistent locked extreme detail gives physical form to the unresponsive connection without creating a new action.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold an ear-level extreme close-up of the vertical phone edge and Aruni's fingers, keeping her face outside the frame as rain travels over the fixed grip.

clips.direction: fixed across empty path toward gate
clips.trigger: The distant bus horn enters the surrounding rain.
clips.motivation: Let empty landscape, rather than camera withdrawal, establish the world's distance from her.
clips.opens_on: Wide view with open path and paddy dominating left, Aruni and Nimal low at the gate on the right.
clips.lands_on: The same wide view with Aruni's phone still at her ear beside the motionless body.
clips.composition_note: Match setup A's position and height; the now-empty left approach outweighs the figures at right.
clips.why: Isolation 4: the production's locked master turns the previously travelled path into negative space while the horn belongs to an unseen world.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold the eye-level wide view as the distant horn sounds, leaving open path and paddy across the left and Aruni with Nimal low beside the gate on the right.

clips.trigger: The horn and rain continue over the final canal tableau.
clips.motivation: Finish with detached spatial distance without competing with the key's singular moving emphasis.
clips.opens_on: Elevated wide view of the path entering left and meeting the gate at right, with Aruni beside Nimal.
clips.lands_on: The same elevated wide geography, figures held small beside the gate.
clips.angle_reason: The elevated oblique makes the pair small within the paddy and canal geometry, expressing isolation without a rising move.
clips.composition_note: Keep both figures at the right-side gate while the path and paddy occupy most of the elevated frame.
clips.why: Isolation 4: the production's locked-off village rule overrides the planner's retreat here, preserving the key as the sole moving peak while elevation supplies distance.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a high, elevated wide view from the field side, keeping the path across the left and both figures small beside the canal gate on the right.

clips.trigger: The canal image gives way to black.
clips.motivation: End the discovery without a visual explanation or transitional flourish.
clips.opens_on: Uniform black filling the entire insert frame.
clips.lands_on: The same uniform black filling every edge.
clips.composition_note: Uniform black has no spatial subject or visible framing reference.
clips.why: Transition 2: an unanimated black plate continues the production's restraint and denies any explanatory image after the unanswered call.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a static, straight-on insert of uniform black, with the entire frame remaining black throughout.

clips.trigger: The initial black interval has established the end of the discovery.
clips.motivation: Provide a motionless black source for the supplied title to be added in post.
clips.opens_on: Uniform black filling the entire insert frame.
clips.lands_on: The same clean black source with no generated lettering.
clips.composition_note: Match setup I exactly; typography belongs to post, not camera generation.
clips.why: Transition 1: the production's restrained ending needs a stable black title source rather than camera animation or generated typography.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold the same static, straight-on insert of uniform black, ending on an unchanged black frame.

notes: scene: 16 of 17 clips hold or float (render still); at most 4 (the production asks for locked-off frames in places: advisory)
